_source: Read out of the running editors on 2026-09-12 via pxt.blocks.requireBlockly(): makecode.microbit.org (target 9.0.12, pxt 13.0.9) and makecode.calliope.cc (target 8.1.15, pxt 13.1.8), both Blockly 13.1.1 with the 'pxt' renderer, a zelos subclass. Paths are each block's svgPath_ d attribute, rows from makeRenderInfo_(block).measure(), positions relative to the parent block. Text widths are the editor's own (16px 600 Consolas/Monaco/Menlo) and only explain the numbers.

constants.FIELD_TEXT_FONT: 600 12pt Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, Ubuntu Mono, source-code-pro, monospace
constants.stroke: colourTertiary = blend(#000, fill, 0.25), 1px; shadow pills are #fff with stroke #bfbfbf, or blend(#fff, parent tertiary, 0.3) when that is darker than luminance 0.15

device_show_number.rows: top 8 (notch) | input y8 h32: sp8 zeige(48) sp8 Zahl(38.4) sp8 socket(40x32 at 110.4) sp8 | spacer 4 | bottom y44 h12 (4 + notch 8)
device_show_number.children: math_number shadow at (110.41, 8), 40x32, fill #fff stroke #bfbfbf: m 16,0 h 8 a 16 16 0 0,1 16,16 v 0 a 16 16 0 0,1 -16,16 V 32 h -8 a 16 16 0 0,1 -16,-16 v 0 a 16 16 0 0,1 16,-16 z; its field text at x 13 (clamped: 46 - 40 min width, 3 each side)
device_show_number.texts: zeige at translate(8,13.5), Zahl at (64.0,13.5): text y=10.5 central, i.e. centreline 24

device_print_message.child: text shadow 95.6x32 at (110.41,8): m 16,0 h 63.6 a 16 16 …; quote glyphs at x=11 and the text at x+8 inside the field group translate(11,5.5); field width 73.6 = text 57.6 + 16

pxt-on-start.rows: top 4 (no notch, no hat) | spacer 4 | input y8 h32 | spacer 8 | statement y48 h24 (sp16 Kp(16,140)) | spacer 8 | bottom y80 h24
pxt-on-start.note: no hat: MakeCode never sets ADD_START_HATS; 'dauerhaft' (device_forever) is the same shape. Width 160 = STATEMENT_INPUT_SPACER_MIN_WIDTH. Statement child at (16, 48).

device_button_event.rows: top 4 | spacer 4 | input y8 h34 (dropdown rect 45.6x34 at (112,8): 8 + A 9.6 + 8 + arrow 12 + 8) | spacer 8 | statement y50 | spacer 8 | bottom 24

controls_if_nested.text: wenn <(1) = (2)> dann … (inside a stack, with a 42-high logic_compare)
controls_if_nested.rows: top 8 | spacer -4 | input y4 h42 (wenn, socket 183.6x42, dann) | spacer 4 | statement y50 h48 | spacer 4 | input y102 h24 (+ button 24x25) | spacer 0 | bottom y126 h12
controls_if_nested.note: tight nesting: a non-shadow inline child >= 40 tall pulls the spacers above and below by 4; the trailing '+' row is a single image field, so its spacers lose 4 and the row loses 8 (32 -> 24).

controls_if_else.rows: top 8 | input y8 h32 (wenn, hex socket 98.4, dann) | spacer 8 | statement y48 h24 | spacer 8 | input y80 h32 (ansonsten 86.4, spacer 80.8, '-' button 24x25) | spacer 8 | statement y120 h24 | spacer 4 | input y148 h24 ('+' button) | spacer 0 | bottom y172 h12

controls_repeat_ext.rows: top 8 | input y8 h32: sp48 socket(40) sp8 '-mal wiederholen' sp8 — the socket is bumped to x=48 past the notch | spacer 8 | statement y48 h48: sp8 mache(48) sp8 Kp(64,…) | spacer 8 | bottom y104 h32 (24 + notch)

device_while.rows: top 8 | input y8 h32 (während 67.2, hex shadow 117.6 at 83.2) | spacer 8 | statement y48 h48 (mache, Kp at 64) | spacer 8 | bottom 32

math_number_shadow.rows: top 4 | input y4 h24 (shadow min 24): sp(16,-3) field(13,14) sp(27,-3) | bottom 4
math_number_shadow.note: width 40 = MIN_BLOCK_WIDTH 8 + 2 x 16; negative spacing clamped to 3 each side

device_get_light_level.rows: top 4 | input y4 h32: sp(20,-8) label(12,105.6) sp(-8) | bottom 4
device_get_light_level.note: field in round: 20 - 12 = 8 negative, so the label starts at x=12

math_arithmetic.rows: top 4 | input y4 h34: sp(21,-17) socket(4,40) sp8 dropdown(52,45.6x34) sp8 socket(105.6,40) sp(-17) | bottom 4
math_arithmetic.children: math_number shadows at (4,5) and (105.6,5), stroke #9a4dbb = blend(#fff, #6f009e, 0.3)

logic_compare.rows: sp(21,0) socket(21,40) sp8 dropdown(69,45.6) sp8 socket(122.6,40) sp(0)
logic_compare.note: round in hexagon: no negative spacing

logic_operation.note: empty hexagon socket: 16 + 2 x 16 wide, 32 high, filled with the block's tertiary colour; hexagon in hexagon: 21 - 8 = 13 negative

variables_set.rows: top 8 | input y8 h34: sp8 setze(48) sp8 dropdown(64,93.6x34) sp8 auf(165.6,28.8) sp8 socket(202.4,40) sp8 | spacer 4 | bottom 12
variables_set.note: next block at y = 50 (body height without the notch)

function_definition.rows: top 20.5 (hat 16.5 + 4) | spacer 4 | input y24.5 h34 | spacer 8 | statement y66.5 h48 | spacer 8 | bottom y122.5 h24

text_join.rows: sp(20,-8) verbinde(12,76.8) sp8 socket(96.8,86) sp8 socket(190.8,76.4) sp8 button(275.2,24) sp8 button(307.2,24) sp(-8)
